summary: Greenland Mines Ltd filed an 8-K regarding a Share Exchange Agreement dated June 15, 2026, to acquire 19,958,503 common shares (9.9% post-closing) of AnorTech Inc., a TSXV-listed company. The consideration was 12,400,000 shares of Greenland common stock, valued based on volume-weighted average price, with a six-month option to acquire up to an additional 25,168,669 AnorTech shares at CAD$0.30 per share or last closing price, payable in stock. The board recommended the transaction; no advisor named. Greenland issued shares under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. The deal grants a toehold stake with potential for further accretion. Watch for regulatory (TSXV) approvals and stock price adjustments on option exercise.
